segments.ja249:1.1: Ekaputtako bhavissasi, tvañca no hessasi issaro kule;
segments.ja249:1.3: Oroha dumasmā sālaka, ehi dāni gharakaṃ vajemase.
segments.ja249:2.1: Nanu maṃ suhadayoti [nanu maṃ hadayeti (sī. pī.)] maññasi, yañca maṃ hanasi veḷuyaṭṭhiyā;
segments.ja249:2.3: Pakkambavane ramāmase, gaccha tvaṃ gharakaṃ yathāsukhanti.
